questionChinese: 你觉得运动重要吗？为什么？
questionPinyin: Nǐ juéde yùndòng zhòngyào ma? Wèi shénme?
questionEnglish: Do you think exercise is important? Why?

questionChinese: 你最好的朋友是什么样的人？
questionPinyin: Nǐ zuì hǎo de péngyǒu shì shénme yàng de rén?
questionEnglish: What kind of person is your best friend?

questionChinese: 如果你有一个星期的假期，你想去哪里旅游？
questionPinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ yǒu yí gè xīngqī de jiàqī, nǐ xiǎng qù nǎlǐ lǚyóu?
questionEnglish: If you had a week off, where would you like to travel?

questionChinese: 你觉得学习外语最难的是什么？
questionPinyin: Nǐ juéde xuéxí wàiyǔ zuì nán de shì shénme?
questionEnglish: What do you think is the hardest part of learning a foreign language?

questionChinese: 你小时候的梦想是什么？现在变了吗？
questionPinyin: Nǐ xiǎo shíhòu de mèngxiǎng shì shénme? Xiànzài biàn le ma?
questionEnglish: What was your childhood dream? Has it changed?
